data.description: Near Lagoons | Corner Oasis | Captivating Community
data.long_description:
Experience luxury living in this captivating 3-bedroom townhouse for sale at Damac Lagoons, Portofino. Presented by Provident Real Estate, this exceptional property offers a lavish waterfront lifestyle surrounded by breathtaking scenery and an array of premier amenities.

Property Details:

3 Bedrooms + Maids
3 Bathrooms
2 Parking Spaces
Close to Lagoons
Corner Unit
Conveniently located, Damac Lagoons provides easy access to key attractions:

10 minutes to Damac Hills and Dubai Autodrome
12 minutes to Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club and Dubai Sports City
22 minutes to Dubai Marina
35 minutes to Dubai International Airport
Set within the meticulously planned Damac Lagoons community, residents enjoy exclusive access to a variety of water-centric amenities, including a crystal lagoon, pristine beachfront areas, and an exciting water park, creating a resort-style living experience. The community also features a clubhouse, zip-lining adventures, an aqua gym, and numerous other leisure and recreational facilities.

Company Details:

Company Name: Provident Real Estate
RERA ORN: 1933
Website: www.providentestate.com

Embrace the epitome of luxury at Damac Lagoons with Provident Real Estate.
